narrative.overview: An Emil-inspired telemetry workspace with warm near-white surfaces, optical Inter, fine neutral edges, layered charcoal actions, and purposeful state motion. The accepted dashboard structure remains; the previous Apple-led visual direction is superseded. Data stays still while user-initiated changes receive brief, zero-bounce feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Optically sized Inter Variable and tabular figures
Warm neutrals and shallow surface depth
Layered charcoal actions and pale neutral navigation
Measured collapses and brief label feedback
Independent section loading with explicit stale/error status

rules.name: State motion
rules.body: Animate user-initiated state changes; never animate incoming telemetry or chart geometry. Initial skeletons breathe unless reduced motion is requested.

rules.name: Honest refresh
rules.body: Keep results on same-query refresh with updating and stale/error status; clear results for changed queries. Protect trace requests from late responses.

rules.name: Quiet input
rules.body: Keyboard input and reduced motion set CSS and Motion transitions to zero. Hidden collapses stay inert and aria-hidden.

dos: Do use optical Inter, aligned numbers, neutral selection, and layered action recipes.
Do retain full-height mobile trace lists with horizontal scrolling, visible focus, and independent section states.
Do keep metric supporting labels and chart dates at 10px, with failed counts at 11px on mobile.
donts: Don't reintroduce blue filled primary actions or an Apple-led visual direction.
Don't animate incoming data or chart geometry.
Don't present stale results as current or allow late trace responses to reopen dismissed details.
